full_prompt_en: A square expressionist oil painting fills the frame with an extreme close-up of a woman's face, built from forceful red, black, and white paint. The top edge cuts through the forehead and dark brows; the lower edge touches the chin, leaving no separate setting or full figure. Her two amber-gold eyes occupy the upper third, looking slightly upward and outward beneath heavy black lids. The left side of the face almost disappears into a dense charcoal shape, while vermilion strokes carve out cheek and temple. Across the center, thick ivory and cool pale-gray paint forms the nose and the broad illuminated plane of the right cheek. Its border is jagged where red and black strokes cut into it. The nostril is a compact black mark with a narrow warm rim. Beneath it, bright crimson lips part enough to reveal a thin dark line, their edges defined by thick raised strokes rather than a smooth contour. The lower right is made of angular pale gray, white, and red patches that suggest the turn of jaw and chin. Brush marks remain blunt and visible everywhere: short scraped streaks, broad palette-knife-like slabs, and small flecks interrupt the color fields. There is little conventional depth or background; the face is compressed close to the surface, and the drama comes from adjacent areas of intense color. Light appears to strike the central ivory plane from the front-left, while the opposite side recedes into black and red shadow. Sharp golden eyes are the most precisely observed features within the rough painterly construction. No legible writing appears. The overall composition makes the gaze and mouth the focal points of a confrontational, high-contrast arrangement of heated red, cool white, and deep black.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现主义油画以女性面部的极近特写填满画面，由有力的红、黑、白颜料堆砌而成。上边缘切过额头和深色眉毛，下边缘触到下巴，没有单独环境或完整人物。两只琥珀金色眼睛位于上方三分之一，在厚重黑色眼睑下微微向上并向外看。脸的左侧几乎消失在浓重的炭黑形体里，朱红笔触刻出面颊和太阳穴。中央厚涂的象牙白与冷浅灰构成鼻子及右脸颊宽阔的受光平面，红黑笔触切入它时留下参差边界。鼻孔是带一圈狭窄暖色边的紧凑黑痕。下方鲜红嘴唇微张，露出一条细暗缝，边缘由隆起的厚重笔触而非平滑轮廓界定。右下角由棱角分明的浅灰、白与红色块构成，暗示下颌与下巴的转折。钝拙而明显的笔痕遍布各处：短促刮擦线、宽阔如调色刀刮出的厚片和细小斑点打断色域。画面几乎没有常规纵深或背景；面部紧贴表面，戏剧性来自相邻的强烈色块。光似乎从正面偏左照在中央象牙白平面，另一侧则退入黑红阴影。锐利金色眼睛是粗粝绘画建构中最精确观察的特征。没有可读文字。整体构图让目光与嘴成为焦点，形成灼热红、冷白和深黑的直面对峙、高反差排列。
style_prompt_en: The image has an expressionist oil-painted surface built from thick, blunt slabs of pigment, scraped streaks, and fractured edges. Vermilion and crimson collide with dense charcoal-black, while cool ivory and pale gray provide abrupt islands of light. Rather than smooth gradients, the volume emerges through hard neighboring color patches and directional strokes; a few small polished details sharpen the focus inside the rougher whole. The dark areas absorb space, and the light areas seem pressed forward against the picture plane. Illumination reads as a concentrated frontal strike with strong lateral falloff, though the painted texture remains more prominent than optical realism. Large angular masses fill the frame with little negative space. The overall effect is intense, tactile, and confrontational.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有表现主义油画表面，由厚重钝拙的颜料片、刮擦笔线和破碎边缘构成。朱红与绯红撞上浓密炭黑，冷象牙白和浅灰提供突然出现的亮色岛屿。体积并非来自平滑渐层，而由相邻的硬色块和定向笔触形成；少量打磨精细的小细节在粗粝整体中锐化焦点。暗色区域吸收空间，浅色区域仿佛被推向画面表层。照明读作集中的正面照射与强烈侧向衰减，尽管绘画肌理比光学写实更突出。大片棱角形体几乎填满画框，负空间极少。整体效果强烈、有触感且咄咄逼人。
theme_en: An extreme close-up face built from red, black, and white paint
theme_zh: 以红黑白厚涂构成的面部极近特写
name: Taras Loboda
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
